verdict.rationale: Productboard's API/webhook framework lets teams route feedback from CRMs and other external tools into Productboard, and the API doc explicitly mentions routing from 'proprietary CRMs, internal tools, and other non-native sources' (a sales/support-adjacent use case), supporting the general integrations theme. However, the evidence pack lacks any explicit mention of native, pre-built connectors to specific support (Zendesk), sales (Salesforce/HubSpot), or chat (Intercom/Slack) tools — it only shows a generic developer API/webhook/MCP toolkit for building custom integrations. Missing for 10: named native integrations with common support/sales/chat platforms, evidence of turnkey setup (not custom-build), and independent confirmation of these integrations working in practice.
